column3: Rare tools are deferred behind one kernel-owned tool_search, with a deferred-tools index section listing name and first sentence
column4: The 2026-11-10 rejection of generic deferral feared a guaranteed round trip; tool declarations were 13.7 KB of a fresh root chat's first request and half of them were tools most conversations never call. The index tells the model they exist, so the round trip happens only on use, once per conversation
column5: measured on the shipped profile with the faux model: 26 tools, 13,732 B before; 16 tools, 7,527 B after. Tests load deferred tools with test/support.ts loadDeferred
column6: shipped; tool-search registers as a kernel extension so presets keep it and do not reconfigure every conversation on each apply
